I implemented all six functions in `minidb/expr_eval.py`, and `tests/test_expr_eval.py` now passes (25 passed). I didn't run the rest of the test suite, and I made no changes to the test file.

I added one private helper, `_check_bool`, which raises `TypeMismatchError` for any operand that isn't a bool or NULL. `logical_not`, `logical_and`, `logical_or` and `where_matches` all use it.

`evaluate` raises `TypeMismatchError` if it is given an expression type outside the known `Expr` union. The docstring doesn't specify that case, so it's my addition.
